blocks.text: Philadelphia’s LeBron James and San Antonio’s Victor Wembanyama are headed back to the NBA Cup quarterfinals. So is Dallas’ Cooper Flagg, along with some teams that are about to experience the knockout round for the first time. Oh, and there will be a new champion as well. The NBA Cup quarterfinals are now set. Detroit, Atlanta, Philadelphia and Boston are on the Eastern Conference side of the bracket, while Dallas, Portland, Memphis and San Antonio — last year’s runner-up — are headed there from the Western Conference.
